status: declared by the pull request that closes #1155 before any score was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published, no rule changes, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored, the live record and pin do not move. The fallback is a draft for Eleonora (docs/decisions/drafts/b2-thin-pool.md), inert until she merges it with her own GO. The turn labels are the draft of #1135 (turn_days), read through turn_days.TurnLabels because that record is not in force. B2 is a benchmark, so nothing here is a candidate's result; the pool minimums (4, 10, 20, 30) are a sensitivity reading and the choice is hers. Development data, never a verdict (scoring protocol v1, #640)
ruling: Eleonora, 22 October 2026, defaults on PR #1139 question 1 (relayed by the orchestrating session)
target: spread_bps at the scored day, as the 23-quantile distribution at each lead h = 1..5 (scoring_protocol.GRID)

measures: the pool each type reads (rows) by arm: the range and the share of cells on a fallback pool

empirical coverage of the 50% and 90% bands and the exceedance rate of q95, under both hit rules (coverage_tests.HIT_RULES), pooled over the five leads, pooled, by regime and by pressure-day type, with Kupiec's p-value where a split has 20 or more cells

grid CRPS and upper-tail twCRPS, paired against B2_turn with the studentized stationary bootstrap (block 10, 10,000 draws, seed 1155), pooled, by regime and by pressure-day type; B2_pool10 against B1 and against B1_prime beside it
reading_rules: none: this is a reading, not a test of a hypothesis. No kill applies. The hit rule is Eleonora's open question (#993): both are reported

amendments.why: Eleonora's ruling on PR #1157 (comment 6370254673, relayed by the orchestrating session): before she approves, measure a minimum pool of 4 beside 10 and 20/30. At 10 the fallback helps year-end but hurts the quarter-end turn, whose 4-6-day trailing-year pool falls to cooler turn days; a minimum of 4 is below the smallest quarter_end_turn pool of the published panel (4), so it should send only year_end to the quarter_end_turn pool. The arm B2_pool4 and the variant count are added; nothing else changes, and the score of the other arms is re-run on the merged tree (origin/main af2d0007), not read from the earlier score.
